prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 630, 'component': 'Health Monitor', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 631, 'component': 'Client Error Reporting SDK', 'region': 'EU-Central', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 632, 'component': 'OAuth Authorization Server', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 633, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 634, 'component': 'SSO Broker', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 635, 'component': 'Central Rate Limiter', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 636, 'component': 'Query Engine', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 637, 'component': 'Push Delivery Worker', 'region': 'EU-Central', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 638, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 639, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 640, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 641, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 642, 'component': 'Certificate-Based Auth Module', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 643, 'component': 'SSO Broker', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 644, 'component': 'Health Monitor', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}]

response: {"incidents": [{"i": 630, "summary": "Critical outage of the APAC Health Monitor lasting an hour; likely blinded observability for that region."}, {"i": 631, "summary": "EU-Central Client Error Reporting SDK down for 60 minutes, creating a blind spot for user-facing failures."}, {"i": 632, "summary": "Global OAuth server experienced major issues for 30 minutes, impacting authentication flows."}, {"i": 633, "summary": "Global Job Scheduler degraded for half an hour, likely causing delays in asynchronous tasks."}, {"i": 634, "summary": "LATAM SSO Broker suffered a critical failure for 30 minutes, blocking user logins."}, {"i": 635, "summary": "US-West Central Rate Limiter went critical for 30 minutes, potentially causing throttling issues or service unavailability."}, {"i": 636, "summary": "EU-West Query Engine was significantly degraded for two hours, impacting data retrieval performance."}, {"i": 637, "summary": "EU-Central Push Delivery Worker hit a critical failure for an hour, likely stopping notifications."}, {"i": 638, "summary": "US-West Job Scheduler saw major disruptions for 60 minutes, affecting background processing."}, {"i": 639, "summary": "US-West Shared SSO Broker had a 30-minute major incident, impacting single sign-on availability."}, {"i": 640, "summary": "LATAM Central Message Queue was down for two hours (critical), likely stalling event processing across the region."}, {"i": 641, "summary": "US-East Social Login Connector experienced major issues for an hour, hindering third-party authentication."}, {"i": 642, "summary": "Global Certificate-Based Auth Module was degraded for three hours, a long-duration major incident impacting secure connections."}, {"i": 643, "summary": "ME SSO Broker suffered a critical two-hour outage, preventing user access via single sign-on."}, {"i": 644, "summary": "LATAM Health Monitor was down for two hours (major), reducing visibility into system status."}]}
